name: subsetix-optim
description: GPU optimization orchestration system for Kokkos CUDA. Automates parallel optimization agents with random personas, GPU benchmarking, and anti-triche verification.
author: Sebastien DUBOIS & HPC@Maths Team

skills.name: orchestrator
skills.description: Main orchestrator for GPU optimization. Launches N agents with random personas in chunks, manages logging, and coordinates the optimization pipeline.

skills.name: benchmark
skills.description: Specialized benchmark agent. Runs sequential GPU benchmarks to avoid interference, with support for custom filters and output formats.

skills.name: antitriche
skills.description: Anti-triche specialist. Verifies baseline integrity, analyzes git diffs, and performs semantic analysis to ensure optimization results are valid.

skills.name: profile
skills.description: GPU profiling specialist using existing CMake presets (Nsight, Kokkos tools, Linux perf). Analyzes top optimization candidates for bottlenecks.

skills.name: combine
skills.description: Optimization combination specialist. Analyzes successful optimizations and proposes compatible combinations to maximize cumulative speedup.

skills.name: report
skills.description: Final report generation specialist. Aggregates benchmark results, anti-triche analysis, and agent summaries into comprehensive markdown report.

examples.name: Full pipeline - 40 agents with custom settings
